subject: Readiness playbook — POC milestone checkpoints
messages:
From: Simon Taylor <simon.taylor@novushealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: elena@novushealth.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Readiness playbook — POC milestone checkpoints

Grace —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're pulling together our internal evaluation plan and want to align on a short, pragmatic MAP for the POC. High level objectives from our side:
- Validate end-to-end latency on our sample traffic profile (~95th percentile)
- Confirm inference cost assumptions for steady-state and burst windows
- Verify data handling / logging to meet our audit needs

Can you send the latest MAP with owners and acceptance criteria? Also wondering whether Redwood can commit to a two-week trial window starting the week of Aug 16 — our internal stakeholders (security + platform) want a clear gate checklist.

Thanks — appreciate a single-sheet view we can circulate.

Simon
Head of Platform Engineering
Novus Health

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Simon Taylor <simon.taylor@novushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:03:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Readiness playbook — POC milestone checkpoints

Hi Simon —

Great to hear you're ready to lock dates. I've attached a focused MAP (MAP_v2.xlsx) that trims our typical plan to a one-page runbook plus an acceptance checklist tab. Key notes up front:

- Proposed POC window: Aug 17–28 (two full business weeks). If you prefer starting Aug 16 we can shift.
- Acceptance criteria (summary):
  • Latency: 95th percentile within agreed threshold for the sample bundle (owner: Redwood Eng).
  • Functional: Feature parity for the inference API calls used in your cases (owner: Novus dev lead).
  • Security: Evidence of audit logs and KMS key handling for sample requests (owner: Redwood Security).
- Blockers we flagged: secure test dataset access, and network egress rules for our measurement hooks.

Action items assigned in the attached sheet. Quick asks for you so we can finalize owners:
1) Confirm Novus internal owner for the acceptance checklist (name + email).
2) Confirm whether the trial needs an isolated VPC (we can provide either hosted or dedicated pool).
3) Point Ben and Marissa to the person who will own security sign-off so we can schedule the questionnaire handoff.

I propose a short kickoff sync (30 min) on Aug 10 to align owners and finalize the runbook. Does 10am PT work for you?

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_v2.xlsx (summary runbook + acceptance checklist)

From: Simon Taylor <simon.taylor@novushealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Brooks <elena@novushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 14:45:20 -0700
Subject: Re: Readiness playbook — POC milestone checkpoints

Grace —

Thanks, got the MAP. Aug 17–28 works for Novus. Quick answers:
- I'll be the overall POC sponsor; primary technical owner is Elena Brooks (elena@novushealth.com).
- We will need the trial to run inside our VPC for data processing visibility; please confirm any networking requirements.
- Security wants a short onboarding package for the questionnaire — can your security lead share an expected evidence list before Aug 10?

If Ben or Marissa can take the security handoff, that would accelerate sign-off. Kickoff on Aug 10 at 10am PT is open for us.

Best,
Simon
